# Bolette Søndergaard

Bolette Søndergaard is a leading senior consultant physician (*ledende overlæge*) at Psykiatrisk Center Glostrup, appearing in the corpus as the representative of Dansk Psykiatrisk Selskab in a steering-group role connected to the Danish ADHD database [^src1]. Her single documented appearance is in the steering-group membership listing found in the ADHD 2024 report [^src1].

This document section covers the steering group members for the ADHD database, along with appendices detailing the database population for the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025. The steering group brings together representatives from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme, and the appendices document the number and demographic distribution of ADHD assessment and treatment pathways among children, adolescents, and adults, as well as regional variation in the use of the "disproven suspicion" pathway marker. Søndergaard's role situates her as one voice for psychiatric professional expertise within this broader quality-assurance and data-governance effort [^src1].

Beyond her listed affiliation and professional-society representation, no further biographical or career details, dates, or additional claims about Bolette Søndergaard are available in the corpus.
